events.text: State elections are held in Germany for the Landtag of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and the Berlin House of Representatives, with an expected decline for the Chancellor Friedrich Merz's party, the CDU.
Japanese triathlete {{ill|Takumi Hojo|ja|北條巧}} wins the first gold medal of the 2026 Asian Games.
